items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: In those days Red Nichols was very popular there.

ctx.x: Good. So we know we're in good shape. Okay. So you went back, and you started playing. Was this the C melody sax?
I bought an alto saxophone. I bought an also saxophone. And I started buying records from here. In those days Red Nichols was very popular there.
